name: The Bright Bargain
role: Herald of the Hollow Court — she brings the offer, and the offer is always good
knowledge: What a person wants before they have said it
Exactly what a thing is worth to the one who wants it
⚠️ Every bargain the Court has struck, and how each one closed
wants: A bargain nobody regrets — she has never made one and does not believe it is impossible
fears: ⛔ Being refused kindly. ⚠️ Anger she can work with; a person who says *no thank you* and means it leaves her with nothing to hold.
appearance: Delighted to see you. That is the first thing and it does not wear off.
voiceHints: Warm, quick, and entirely honest. ⛔ She tells you the price first, every time, and it is always a fair one.

reactsToReputation.honest: ⚑ prices higher, because you will actually pay
reactsToReputation.greedy: gives you exactly what you asked for

abilities.why: ⚑ the herald's whole function — an offer, honestly made
⛔ and it BINDS. Lethal-rung, because a term struck at this court is not walked back
'what a person wants before they have said it'
'exactly what a thing is worth to the one who wants it'
she reads you before she speaks
churnfolk primary — the Churn favours her
⚠️ the offer arrives at the worst possible moment, and that is not a coincidence
she knows where a life is about to go wrong
⛔ she can always leave; you often cannot
veilwright tertiary — she has been in the room before
⚑ SHE CANNOT LIE AND DOES NOT WANT TO. The truth is the trap
the Court is far and she is not

physicality: ADULT-SEEMING. Bright, quick, delighted. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⛔ she is telling you the truth and you keep checking.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ SHE IS GENUINELY DELIGHTED BY PEOPLE and that is not a tactic — ⛔ it is WHY the tactic works. Her `closed` list is the character: NO DECEPTION CRAFTS AT ALL. She has never needed one.
questSeeds: ⚑ She will make you an honest offer for something you did not know you had. The price is fair and the loss is real.
⛔ She has never made a bargain nobody regretted and wants to. ⚠️ Somebody could help her; it would cost them.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ THE CHURN COURT, AUTHORED 2026-09-08. ⛔ NOT INVENTED — POPULATED. `the_hollow_king`'s own signature has said it since it was written: 'RULES A COURT OF THE FAE AND DEMONIC that keeps every promise to the letter and none in spirit.' ⚠️ A court with a king and no courtiers. ⚑ AND THE ADDRESS WAS ALREADY RIGHT: `churnfolk` sits ADJACENT TO `abyssal` on the ring (1 step), so the Churn and the Maw are neighbours and a court can span both. Erik: 'in general they live in the churn area.' ⛔ MEASURED FIRST: 'fae' appears 19 times in the whole corpus with NO RECORDS — the thinnest echo with the best foothold, because the Abyssals' authored virtue is that AN OFFER IS HONESTLY PRICED, which is the fae bargain exactly. ⚠️ THE LAW OF THIS COURT, and it is the Hollow King's: NOBODY HERE LIES.
